technical.summary: STZ shows solid bullish structure with EMA golden cross and price above all major MAs, but weak trend strength (ADX 15.3), lack of fresh entry signals, and low volatility limit swing trade probability.

fundamental.summary: STZ shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk (85 days away) — insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (32/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (146+ days old) with mixed signals and no recent conviction; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro stress with VIX at crisis levels (358.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar headwind for multinational STZ, and imminent CPI event creating near-term volatility; earnings in 85 days provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross with price above all major moving averages and RSI bullish across all timeframes provides solid technical structure, while extreme market fear (32/100) creates contrarian buy opportunity near support at 223.21.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend confirmation (ADX 15.32), absence of fresh entry signals (MACD/Stochastic/PSAR inactive), low volume (0.94 ratio), Bollinger Band squeeze, zero fundamental conviction, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, strong dollar) make this a low-probability swing trade with high execution risk.

decision.entry_rationale: EMA golden cross and price above all major moving averages provide bullish structure, and extreme market fear creates contrarian opportunity near support.
